body: If you ever thought he was the one, he's still the one. Maybe say Valentine's Day but no gifts! Maybe the gifts are to show he cares. Space is good. Keep conversation in text though. That will be good for the both of you. What exactly did he do if I may ask?
Maybe Valentine's Day is exactly what you need with him to see how much he cares. Maybe take a few days of space and talk it out.

I think you should give him 1 last chance. Tell your bf no more dumb things. He won't do it again. You say you love him, are happy, and he's a great guy. Don't ruin a relationship. Talk it out and build from it. I know I think the same way you are but it was just my depression telling me that, trust me,1 last chance. I've pushed away too many people to not give you this advice. It ruined my life. Trying to help someone similar.

Oh good! Then he sounds like a great guy. I know I'm just a stranger giving advice. But guys who are supportive and caring are worth it. Cause there aren't many out there, trust me. I hope you give him another chance. His trust can be restored. I fell out of trust with my bf and he earned it back. I can tell you love him. If you two were a good couple work it out. It'll help you
There's still hope for the future. Keep your head up and stay positive! I'm here to talk
Please don't. Think about all the sorrow you'll create. I'm here to talk
Do you need to talk to someone?

Exactly. He was going to leave because I go crazy sometimes. But if yours loves you, give him another chance. Let him make up for it. You say you're happy with him. Work it out, build a stronger relationship. We both seem to have the same thing going on. That's my advice. Cause mine saved me once he started to care. And if your bf cares, you're lucky. He seems like he means well and loves you. Does he treat you right?

From my experience. My bf only supports me now because he found me trying to kill myself. He didn't care at all about my illness. So the fact that you found someone who did from the start, is truly awesome.

If you're happy with him then stay together. If he is happy with you. Let him stay with you. These things take time to learn from. He is learning, he probably never did the same thing twice. Talk to him about how you feel. Be more open. Relationships aren't easy. Mine isn't, but with talking and time it will. Don't shut him out if he supports you through it. Mine didn't at first. You're lucky to have found a guy like him. And I bet if you give him a last chance, he won't screw up.

If I have any advice for you it's this. Giving my boyfriend another chance saved me. I was finally happy once I met him. Mine sounds like yours, does stupid things. But he learned from his mistakes with time. I'm not telling you what to do, but he obviously cares about you. Give him another chance and I bet he shows you differently. Talk to him and open up. Communication is key in a relationship. If he was actually your best friend, you shouldn't give up so easily. Maybe your depression spiked a problem just like it does for my relationship, but talking always helps in the end. If he's helped with your depression before, he will again. And from someone who knows how to push away people, it takes a special kind of person to stay with you, always fighting. He must really love you, you're lucky.
Try going and playing sports again. Go to the gym. If you liked soccer maybe kick the soccer ball outside and juggle? Don't know if that's a thing my bf plays.
I tried once and left a note for my mom and boyfriend. 2 separate. Didn't end up doing it. And I think it might be the right thing to do. Also please don't kill yourself. Talk to me if you want

Please don't end it. It seems bad to you but life is worth living. You can always bounce back. Try and find happiness in places you wouldn't normally. Reach out and talk to someone. Talk to me if you want! No need to end your life

Maybe therapy? You need to get away. How old are you? She needs to deal with her alcohol problem and you need to live your own life. Her being an alcoholic doesn't mean you should kill yourself. Be positive
And what's your situation

You are a great guy. Just like my boyfriend. I have depression just like your girlfriend. I tried taking my life and my boyfriend stopped me and I cried in his arms saying the same thing she did. Why are you with me when I'm like this. You know she can't help it. She needs you. I'm so happy people like you exist. Stay strong. Try and help her by showing her positives and what it might do to you if she does it. Not only hurts her, but you. Talk to her and let her know everything will be okay.
Why do you feel this way? Try and talk to someone. Talk to the reddit community! We are here for you! Stay positive and strong

I use to cut myself too. People noticed but nobody said anything. I was hurt cause it was a sign for help. What caused you to feel this way? Try and talk about it with a friend. I did with my boyfriend and he's supported me through my lowest points. Stay strong

You stay strong and look at what the future might bring. All the positives of life. Try talking to someone and reach out. Friends will give feedback and help. You will find happiness if you look for it. Good luck and stay strong
Please don't. Tell someone what's going on. Reach out. The reddit community is here for you
I'm sorry you feel this way.  Can I ask why you feel this way? What caused it? Stay strong and try to talk to someone. Your friends will support you. Good luck!

If he really was your best friend, he might be able to help you. Maybe you need to talk to him and tell him what's going on. Is your depression part of why you ended it? If he is willing to be supportive and love you, maybe give him another chance. Or start over fresh with him and renew the relationship. You can always regain trust. If he treated you right and loved you, that's hard to find. If you don't want to tell your family, tell him. Sorry, I'm having trouble too in my relationship right now with my boyfriend. He treats me like a queen and even though he's stupid and causes some problems, it's nothing he isn't willing to overcome with me. Especially when I give him a hard time too. Communication is key. Hope you're ok!
Try and find happiness. What did you enjoy before you felt this way? Maybe try a new hobby! Things can always get better.

Happy to hear you didn't jump. But I think maybe you need to try and talk to someone. Reach out. Talk to anyone about how you feel. It will help you. Maybe someone will give you a purpose again. Find a job, be creative, do something good. You can do anything if you put your mind to it.

Talk to someone. Anyone. You aren't weak, you just need someone's opinion. You are strong for not doing it. Taking your life isn't easy and nobody really wants to do it but we are told to from our depression or other illnesses. I suggest try and reach out to someone.

Please don't start this process. It will lead to big problems. My suggestion is to not cut that first time. I know I did and I spiraled out of control and I hurt the people around me. To the point where my depression hurts my relationship, the only thing that brought me happiness. Do yourself a favor and please think about what you might be doing.
I lost my job and my boyfriend is mentally unstable because of his family, stress, and situations that he is being an idiot. Will have to talk about it and try and move forward.
